overview: This enum sets the rarity tier of a shop lottery prize.

None.simple: This marks a lottery prize with no rarity.
None.technical: EGameShopLotteryRarityType::None is the constructor default for FGameDataTableRow_ShopLotteryLineup::Rariry. RefreshLineup has no case for it, so the prize is not placed in the listed groups. The header color lookup uses Rariry - 1 as an index, which is negative here and falls back to black.

Bronze.simple: This is the bronze prize tier.
Bronze.technical: EGameShopLotteryRarityType::Bronze places the prize in the Bronze group, shown after Gold and Silver and before sold-out entries. Its header color uses HeaderColors[0]. A replaced draw grants ITM_SET_SHOP_LOTTERY_REPLACE_BRONZE and the result animation OnPlayResult_Bronze plays.

Silver.simple: This is the silver prize tier.
Silver.technical: EGameShopLotteryRarityType::Silver places the prize in the Silver group, shown after Gold and before Bronze. Its header color uses HeaderColors[1]. A replaced draw grants ITM_SET_SHOP_LOTTERY_REPLACE_SILVER and the result animation OnPlayResult_Silver plays.

Gold.simple: This is the gold prize tier.
Gold.technical: EGameShopLotteryRarityType::Gold places the prize in the Gold group, shown first in the lineup. Its header color uses HeaderColors[2]. A replaced draw grants ITM_SET_SHOP_LOTTERY_REPLACE_GOLD and the result animation OnPlayResult_Gold plays.

Invalid.simple: This is an undefined lottery rarity.
Invalid.technical: EGameShopLotteryRarityType::Invalid reaches the default branch in the lineup grouping switch, so it is not listed. Its header color index is outside HeaderColors and falls back to black, and the replacement and animation switches grant no point set and start no result animation. No exported lineup row uses this value.

notes: The field is named Rariry in the reconstructed row struct and sits at row offset 0x1C.

RefreshLineup sorts each rarity group by displayed weight rate, then by item set SortingOrder, and assembles the final list as available Gold, Silver, Bronze followed by sold-out Gold, Silver, Bronze.
The header color index is the enum value minus one. Values outside the HeaderColors array use black.
Replacement rewards and result animations are defined only for Bronze, Silver, and Gold. A replacement happens when the first item in the prize set is already at its PossessionMax.
